# 75450 - Dual peripheral driver

Package DIP-14 · family 754xx · catalogue file [catalog/chips/75450.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/75450.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 45 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![75450 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/75450.png) | ![75450 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-75450.png) | ![75450 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-75450.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | SUB | ground |  | substrate: must always be at the most negative voltage of the device |
| 1 | G | input |  | input common to both NAND gates |
| 2 | 1A | input |  |  |
| 13 | 2A | input |  |  |
| 3 | 1Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 12 | 2Y | output | totem-pole |  |
| 4 | 1B | analog |  | base of output transistor 1 (normally wired to 1Y) |
| 5 | 1C | output | open-collector-high-voltage | collector of output transistor 1 |
| 6 | 1E | analog |  | emitter of output transistor 1 (normally grounded) |
| 11 | 2B | analog |  | base of output transistor 2 |
| 10 | 2C | output | open-collector-high-voltage | collector of output transistor 2 |
| 9 | 2E | analog |  | emitter of output transistor 2 |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3,12 | Y = NOT (A AND G) | TTL NAND gate (datasheet: Y = (AG)', gate only). |
| 5,10 | C = A AND G (with Y wired to B and E to ground) | Datasheet: C = AG for gate and transistor together; C is off (high, pulled up externally) when A and G are high, on (low) otherwise. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| outputMaxVoltageV | 30 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Gate outputs Y: VOL 0.4 V at 16 mA, VOH 2.4 V at -400 uA (test conditions). Transistors: abs max collector current 300 mA, collector-emitter 30 V (RBE &lt;= 500 ohm), collector-base 35 V, emitter-base 5 V; VCE(sat) 0.25/0.4 V at 100 mA, 0.5/0.7 V at 300 mA. The fields here give the gate output figures; outputMaxVoltageV 30 V is the transistor collector-emitter rating. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or G | Y | PLH | 12 | 22 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A or G | Y | PHL | 8 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A or G | C (gate and transistor) | PLH | 20 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, IC ~200 mA, CL 15 pF, RL 50 ohm |
| A or G | C (gate and transistor) | PHL | 20 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, IC ~200 mA, CL 15 pF, RL 50 ohm |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin |
|---|---|
| transistorSwitching | C |

## Not known

- Recommended operating conditions give no output currents; IOL/IOH are the gate VOL/VOH test conditions. The 300 mA transistor current is an absolute maximum, not a recommended figure.
- Datasheet read is the 'B' version (replaces the original 75450).
- No minimum delays printed.

## Sources

- [TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, Series 55450B/75450B dual peripheral drivers (bulletin DL-S 7311798, Sep 1973, tentative data sheet)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1974_TI_The_Interface_Data_Book_for_Design_Engineers_Second_Edition.pdf) - 6-42, 6-43, 6-46, 6-47 (PDF pages 272, 273, 276, 277); SN75450B (pages titled 'TYPE SN75450')
